## Checklist (see CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] Tests pass locally; new logic has a test

- [ ] Docs / agent instructions updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] Docs: update `docs/<area>.md` for the area you changed (the README only changes for install, build or a new doc)

- [ ] No copyrighted material, personal data or secrets
- [ ] Labelled `needs-human-check` if it must be heard, played or seen
